package com.ntt.crosstest.audit

import android.app.Application
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModelStore
import com.ntt.crosstest.data.*
import com.ntt.crosstest.ui.viewmodels.MemberDetailViewModel
import io.github.jan.supabase.SupabaseClient
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.Auth
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.MemoryCodeVerifierCache
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.MemorySessionManager
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.auth
import io.github.jan.supabase.auth.user.UserSession
import io.github.jan.supabase.createSupabaseClient
import io.github.jan.supabase.postgrest.Postgrest
import io.ktor.client.engine.mock.MockEngine
import io.ktor.client.engine.mock.respond
import io.ktor.http.HttpHeaders
import io.ktor.http.headersOf
import kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.ExperimentalCoroutinesApi
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.StandardTestDispatcher
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.resetMain
import kotlinx.coroutines.test.setMain
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner
import org.robolectric.RuntimeEnvironment
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config

@OptIn(ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
@Config(application = Application::class, sdk = [34])
class MemberDetailPaginationIndependentTest {
    private val admin = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
    private val target = "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
    private val time = "2026-11-01T08:00:00Z"

    private inner class FixtureRepository(client: SupabaseClient) : AdminManagementRepository(client) {
        val creditGate = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
        var creditPageStarted = false
        override suspend fun getMemberOverview(userId: String) = AdminMemberOverview(id = target)
        override suspend fun getMyCapabilities() = AdminMyCapabilities(callerId = admin, role = "admin")
        override suspend fun getMemberCreditHistory(userId: String, limit: Int, cursorCreatedAt: String?, cursorId: String?): AdminCreditHistoryEnvelope {
            if (cursorId == null) return AdminCreditHistoryEnvelope(
                items = listOf(AdminCreditHistoryItem("credit1", target, 1, createdAt = time)),
                hasMore = true, nextCursor = AdminDateTimeCursor(time, "credit1"),
            )
            creditPageStarted = true
            creditGate.await()
            return AdminCreditHistoryEnvelope(items = listOf(AdminCreditHistoryItem("credit2", target, 2, createdAt = time)))
        }
        override suspend fun getMemberDailyTasks(userId: String, limit: Int, cursorDate: String?) = AdminMemberDailyTasksEnvelope()
        override suspend fun getMemberWarnings(userId: String, limit: Int, cursorCreatedAt: String?, cursorId: String?) =
            if (cursorId == null) AdminMemberWarningsEnvelope(
                items = listOf(AdminMemberWarningItem("warning1", target, message = "one", createdAt = time)),
                hasMore = true, nextCursor = AdminDateTimeCursor(time, "warning1"),
            ) else AdminMemberWarningsEnvelope(items = listOf(AdminMemberWarningItem("warning2", target, message = "two", createdAt = time)))
    }

    @Test fun concurrentCreditAndWarningPaginationDoesNotDiscardCreditPageOrLeaveSpinner() = runBlocking {
        val dispatcher = StandardTestDispatcher()
        Dispatchers.setMain(dispatcher)
        val app: Application = RuntimeEnvironment.getApplication()
        SessionCacheManager.clear(app)
        val store = ViewModelStore()
        val client = createSupabaseClient("https://fixture.invalid", "dummy") {
            install(Auth) {
                sessionManager = MemorySessionManager()
                codeVerifierCache = MemoryCodeVerifierCache()
                autoLoadFromStorage = false
                autoSaveToStorage = false
                enableLifecycleCallbacks = false
            }
            install(Postgrest)
            httpEngine = MockEngine { respond("{}", headers = headersOf(HttpHeaders.ContentType, "application/json")) }
        }
        try {
            client.auth.importSession(Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true }.decodeFromString<UserSession>(
                """{"access_token":"fixture-token","refresh_token":"fixture-ref","expires_in":3600,"token_type":"bearer","user":{"id":"$admin","aud":"authenticated"}}"""
            ))
            val repository = FixtureRepository(client)
            val vm = MemberDetailViewModel(target, repository, AuthRepository(client, app), Localizer(app))
            store.put("member", vm)
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            assertFalse(vm.uiState.value.isLoading)
            assertTrue(vm.uiState.value.creditHasMore)
            assertTrue(vm.uiState.value.warningsHasMore)

            vm.loadMoreCreditHistory()
            dispatcher.scheduler.runCurrent()
            assertTrue(repository.creditPageStarted)
            assertTrue(vm.uiState.value.isCreditsLoading)
            vm.loadMoreWarnings()
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()
            repository.creditGate.complete(Unit)
            dispatcher.scheduler.advanceUntilIdle()

            assertFalse("Starting warning pagination must not strand the credit spinner", vm.uiState.value.isCreditsLoading)
            assertEquals(listOf("credit1", "credit2"), vm.uiState.value.creditHistory.map { it.id })
            assertEquals(listOf("warning1", "warning2"), vm.uiState.value.warnings.map { it.id })
        } finally {
            store.clear()
            client.close()
            SessionCacheManager.clear(app)
            Dispatchers.resetMain()
        }
    }
}

      "created_at": "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z"

### 4.2 `admin_schedule_carryover_policy`
Lên lịch chính sách cộng dồn từ một ngày tương lai (phải lớn hơn ngày hôm nay theo giờ Việt Nam).

- **RPC Name**: `public.admin_schedule_carryover_policy`
- **Caller Guard**: Unlocked Admin
- **Tham số**:
  - `p_effective_from` (`date`, required): Ngày bắt đầu áp dụng (`> VN today`)
  - `p_is_enabled` (`boolean`, required): Bật (`true`) hoặc tắt (`false`)
  - `p_operator_note` (`text`, required): Ghi chú lý do của quản trị viên
  - `p_expected_revision` (`bigint`, optional): Phiên bản revision hiện tại để chống xung đột ghi đè
  - `p_request_id` (`uuid`, optional): Mã định danh yêu cầu chống trùng
- **Trả về**:
  ```json
  {
    "success": true,
    "effective_from": "2026-11-05",
    "is_enabled": false,
    "operator_note": "Tạm tắt cộng dồn bảo trì",
    "revision": "5"
  }
  ```
- **Lỗi có thể xảy ra**:
  - `CANNOT_MODIFY_HISTORICAL_POLICY`: Ngày hiệu lực không thuộc tương lai
  - `REVISION_CONFLICT`: Revision đã thay đổi trước khi lưu
  - `INVALID_EFFECTIVE_DATE`: Ngày hiệu lực không hợp lệ

### 4.3 `admin_cancel_future_carryover_policy`
Hủy một chính sách tương lai đã lên lịch trước đó.

- **RPC Name**: `public.admin_cancel_future_carryover_policy`
- **Caller Guard**: Unlocked Admin
- **Tham số**:
  - `p_effective_from` (`date`, required): Ngày hiệu lực cần hủy (`> VN today`)
  - `p_reason` (`text`, required): Lý do hủy bỏ
  - `p_expected_revision` (`bigint`, optional): Revision dự kiến
  - `p_request_id` (`uuid`, optional): Mã định danh yêu cầu
- **Trả về**:
  ```json
  {
    "success": true,
    "cancelled_date": "2026-11-05",
    "reason": "Hủy bỏ lịch tắt bảo trì",
    "revision": "6"
  }
  ```
- **Lỗi có thể xảy ra**:
  - `POLICY_NOT_FOUND`: Không tìm thấy chính sách tương lai ứng với ngày đã cho
  - `CANNOT_CANCEL_NON_FUTURE_POLICY`: Không được hủy chính sách hiện hành hoặc quá khứ

enum class BusinessPolicyAdminTab {
    ACTIVE, SCHEDULED, EDITOR, HISTORY
}

fun friendlyBusinessPolicyError(e: Throwable, localizer: Localizer): String {
    val msg = e.message.orEmpty()
    val lower = msg.lowercase()
    return when {
        "business_policy_conflict" in lower -> localizer.get(R.string.error_business_policy_conflict)
        "business_policy_price_mismatch" in lower -> localizer.get(R.string.error_business_policy_price_mismatch)
        "business_policy_future_date_required" in lower -> localizer.get(R.string.error_business_policy_future_date_required)
        "business_policy_note_required" in lower -> localizer.get(R.string.error_business_policy_note_required)
        "business_policy_not_found" in lower -> localizer.get(R.string.error_business_policy_not_found)
        "business_policy_history_read_only" in lower -> localizer.get(R.string.error_business_policy_history_read_only)
        "client_update_required" in lower -> localizer.get(R.string.error_client_update_required)
        "request_id_conflict" in lower -> localizer.get(R.string.error_request_id_conflict)
        "insufficient_credits" in lower -> localizer.get(R.string.profile_insufficient_credits)
        else -> friendlyError(e, localizer)
    }
}

data class AdminBusinessPolicyUiState(
    val activeTab: BusinessPolicyAdminTab = BusinessPolicyAdminTab.ACTIVE,
    val isLoading: Boolean = false,
    val isActionInProgress: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null,
    val successMessage: String? = null,

    // Policy Config & Active/Scheduled
    val config: BusinessPolicyConfigResponse? = null,
